title: Uniqueness of Halting Output
statement: For any extended program, input bit string, coin string, and word width, suppose the program halts within time $t$ with output value $v$ and output string $o$, touching at most $f$ memory addresses. If it also halts within time $t'$ with output value $v'$ and output string $o'$, touching at most $f'$ addresses, then $v=v'$ and $o=o'$.
hypotheses_covered: The program, input, coin string, word width, time bounds, output values, output strings, and touch limits are arbitrary
